title: Reading Drill — Testing a lower stage for assemblies — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a lower stage for assemblies — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Cairnford began with reports of speakers becoming harder to see from the back. The hall technician had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using seat-by-seat checks and chose the distance at which a speaker's face is clear as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was staggered rows. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted four weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded differences in audience height as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
